# ExtractPDF

> Pay-per-use PDF and document text extraction for AI agents.
> $0.005 USDC per extraction. No API key. No account. No subscription.
> Accepts payment on Base, Arc, and Polygon via x402.

## What it does

POST a public URL of any PDF or DOCX document and receive:
- Clean extracted plain text (up to 50,000 characters)
- Page count, title, author metadata
- Format detection (pdf / docx / text)

## Endpoint

POST https://extractpdf.xyz/api/extract
Content-Type: application/json
X-PAYMENT: <x402 payment header>

Body: { "url": "https://example.com/document.pdf" }

## Payment

Price: $0.005 USDC per call
Networks: Base (eip155:8453), Arc (eip155:5042), Polygon (eip155:137)
Protocol: x402 v1 — send X-PAYMENT header with signed USDC authorization

Without a payment header, the endpoint returns HTTP 402 with the full payment requirements.

## Response example

{
  "url": "https://example.com/report.pdf",
  "text": "Executive Summary\n\nThis report covers...",
  "pages": 12,
  "chars": 8432,
  "title": "Annual Report 2024",
  "author": "Jane Smith",
  "format": "pdf",
  "extracted_at": "2026-10-08T14:00:00.000Z"
}

## Supported formats

- PDF (.pdf) — full text and metadata extraction
- DOCX (.docx) — full text extraction
- Plain text — returned as-is

## Links

- Homepage: https://extractpdf.xyz
- OpenAPI spec: https://extractpdf.xyz/openapi.json
- Health check: GET https://extractpdf.xyz/api/extract
